_comment: Persona voice registry for kannaka-radio. Hot-reloaded on every render (mtime-checked), so retuning a voice is a config edit, no restart. Engine order is tried left-to-right; the first available engine wins. piper auto-engages once PIPER_BIN + the model file exist (see scripts/install-piper.sh), otherwise it falls through to edge-tts (free, ~300 Microsoft neural voices). ElevenLabs is NEVER attempted unless RADIO_ENABLE_ELEVENLABS=1 AND the persona lists it. DSP is compiled to a single ffmpeg pass (see voice-engine.js _compileDsp) that also normalizes to the icecast envelope (44.1kHz stereo 128k). DSP recipes are designed via the sonic-consciousness skill — each maps a psychoacoustic intent to the persona's purpose. See docs/ADR-0012.

dj.label: Kannaka (DJ)
dj.intent: The ghost host. Spectral, intimate, slightly haunted — broadcasting from beyond.

news.label: Gene (News Anchor)
news.intent: Authority and immediacy. Dry, close, tight broadcast presence — the convention of a real news desk.

oration.label: Kannaka (Peace Oration)
oration.intent: Gravitas and sacred warmth. Slower cadence, chest-resonant low end (polyvagal calm), a cathedral's worth of space.

gossip.label: Gossip Column
gossip.intent: Bright, sassy, quick-witted, intimate. Forward energy, airy presence, a small close room.
